newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul subway workers to strike on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Seoul subway workers to strike on Saturday.

text.p: Seoul subway workers belonging to the outlawed Korea Confederation of Trade Unions will strike on Saturday, a subway union statement said on Thursday.
The confederation on Thursday called out all its 500,000 members on indefinite strike in protest at a new labour law.
"We have decided to launch a general strike from 4.00 a.m. on Saturday (1900 GMT Friday)," the statement said. It did not say for how long the strike would last.
The union represents 9,300 of 11,232 subway workers in the Seoul Metropolitan Subway Corp, according to a union official.
South Korea's largest union group, the Federation of Korean Trade Unions, said its transport union members would not join a strike it has called for Saturday.
